messages:
maria: Quick UX pass — noticed a dragging shadow hides the insertion marker in compact rules list; preview sim legend also truncates at narrow widths.
nina: Can repro. Appears when we animate with transform; the placeholder height/anchor is off by a few px.
charlie: For visuals, make the dragged item 90% scale + translucent, and add a 1px dashed placeholder so the drop anchor is always visible.
anya: A11y: screen reader says only 'dragging' not the destination. Need aria-live polite on drop: "Rule 'Refund' moved to position 2 of 5." Also ensure keyboard reorder exposes a focusable insertion point and visible focus ring.
kevin: Hit-testing note: switch dragged element to position:absolute during drag so visual and event hitboxes match. I'll PR this.
nina: I'll implement the dashed placeholder + shrink and verify hit areas.
kevin: Also re-anchor validation toasts to the rules panel to avoid overlapping sim controls; collapse legend under a chevron below 720px to prevent truncation.
maria: Copy tweak for empty sim: change to "No routing rules match this input yet. Try relaxing filters or add a rule." Can we land that with the copy PR?
lydia: I'll run a screen reader sweep after merges and share failing utterances for QA.
ux-bot: Checklist: add unit test for placeholder calc; add accessibility checklist item for reorder announcements; update design spec with dashed-placeholder mock. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks everyone — tagging for sprint planning 🚀
